notes.title: 60% discount and future plans
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36175022/8ba84f795093cba5ff115b79930be7db996c706d.jpg[/img]

🦉Hi guys,
Steam Summer Sale is here and you can enjoy 60% discount. We would like to present you the news that awaits you in the coming months.

Right now we are working on enlarging the current map, the city will be a bit bigger and we will add nature next to the city. The update is scheduled for next month (July).

A big update is planned for August, where a new map and especially new game mechanics will be waiting for you. We plan to redesign the mini-game system a bit and add a few new ones, so you have something to look forward to. 😉

notes.title: Update #1 - Achievements and change of region
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36175022/a58b2c8643dbb9b920facfb078710201985cb743.jpg[/img]

Hello,
in our first update of Bird Simulator we have added ability to change a region. Before you connect to the online version, you can choose the nearest region.

Another big thing is Achievement system. You can try to unlock 15 regular achievements. There are also 2 hidden achievements that are not easy to find.

We will try to bring more updates as soon as possible. Until then, enjoy the game :)

notes.title: What can you expect in the coming weeks / months?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36175022/61564499defbef89c2c6b8f73b91ec93fcd4714f.png[/img]

Hello,
right now we are working on bug fixes, but we’d like to introduce the new features you can expect in the coming weeks / months:
[list]
[*] Flying improvements
[*] Achievements
[*] Linux and Mac version
[*] gradually enlarging existing maps and add new elements to the map
[*] Partial support for game controller
[/list]

A larger update with more new content is likely to be added during March. It will contain a new map and birds.

We are also working on a mobile version. This version should help us bring more players to the game.

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Hi guys,
just a small update. We have fixed some problems with camera movement and rendering. The camera should no longer move underground and behind buildings.
